blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.
blocks.zh: 最近多模式搜索代理使用推理、视觉和网络现场搜索等多种方式,通过组织一个手动搜索和视觉工具的小型图书馆来回答超出参数化知识的问题。 然而,当在野外遇到新的查询类型,证据格式,以及故障模式时,图书馆很难创建和维护,并被冻结. 相比之下,人类从业者则通过从熟悉的部分形成新的工具并跨任务再利用这些工具来解决工具不足的问题。 受此启发,我们提出 ToolSmith,一个自动工具生成框架,在精益基工具库上生长和再利用模块. 我们评价了根据VLM-as-a-Judge协议的三项域内多式联运搜索基准和十项域外基准。 ToolSmith在各种规模的部署人员中不断改进基础库,更大的骨干力量收获了更大的收益,显示了这一方法的可扩展性。 我们的代码和数据见https://teesr.github.io/toolsmith/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal search agents ( Geng et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Narayan et al., 2025 ) answer information-seeking questions beyond static knowledge inside the model, such as identifying the source of the rare knowledge, cross-checking a numerical claim against the live web, or assembling a multi-step provenance argument across images and retrieved pages. Contemporary systems handle such tasks by orchestrating reasoning, perception, and live web search across many turns over a fixed inventory of hand-crafted tools. It typically contains web search, webpage fetching, image grounding, OCR, depth estimation, and code execution. Throughout this paper, we use tool to mean a callable Python utility, exposed to the agent through a typed schema, that takes structured input (a text query, an image, a URL) and returns evidence the agent’s reasoning loop consumes in a subsequent turn; generating a new tool means producing a new such callable schema, execution logic, and all, and admitting it to the catalog the agent draws from at inference.
blocks.zh: 多式联运搜索代理商(Geng等,2026;Huang等,2026;Yao等,2026;Chen等,2026a;Wu等,2025;Narayan等,2025;Narayan等,2025)在模型内解答静态知识以外的信息搜索问题,如确定稀有知识的来源,对照直播网络交叉核对数字索赔,或收集跨图像和检索页面的多步骤出处论证. 当代系统通过协调推理、感知和现场网络搜索处理这些任务,这些搜索跨越许多系统,转而对手工制作的工具进行固定的清点。 它通常包含网页搜索、网页取取、图像定位、OCR、深度估计和代码执行。 在整个本文中,我们使用工具来指代一个可调用的 Python 工具,通过打入的计数器接触了代理,它需要结构化的输入(文本查询,图像,URL),并返回代理推理循环在随后的转折中消耗的证据;生成出一个新的工具意味着产生新的这种可调的计数器,执行逻辑,以及所有,并承认代理从推断中得出的目录.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, hand-crafted tools suffer from inherent limitations. First, tool inventories shipped with production systems and developer-curated skill banks ( VoltAgent and Contributors, 2026 ) are expensive to maintain and frozen at the developer’s anticipated coverage. When new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild, human intervention will be needed to modify the tools. Second, complementary lines of work that learn memory over a fixed inventory ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) or train an agent to use existing tools more efficiently ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) sharpen how the agent uses its tools but do not expand which tools it has.
blocks.zh: 然而,手工制作的工具受到固有的限制。 首先,与生产系统和开发商精准技能库(VoltAgent and Contriductors, 2026)一起运输的工具库存在开发商预期的覆盖范围内维持和冻结费用昂贵。 当在野外遇到新的查询类型,证据格式和故障模式时,需要人为干预来修改工具. 第二,通过固定清单(Xiao等,2025年)学习内存或训练代理人更高效地利用现有工具的补充工作(Gao等,2025年;Wu等,2026年)使代理人使用其工具的方式更加明确,但不扩展其拥有哪些工具。

blocks.en: A natural alternative is letting the agent itself generate the missing tool. Tool generation has been studied across adjacent domains such as vision–language understanding, math and table QA, general NLP, and embodied / computer-use agents ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wölflein et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , but has not been carried over to multimodal search, where the inventory remains hand-authored. The transfer is non-trivial: search-agent trajectories are long, and agent state mixes images, link references, and tool outputs across turns.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的替代品是让代理本身生成缺失的工具. 工具生成在相邻领域进行了研究,如视觉-语言理解、数学和表QA、通用NLP和内含/计算机使用剂(Chen等,2024;Yuan等,2024;Wölflein等,2025;Wang等,2023;Wang等,2025等),但并未转入多模式搜索,库存仍由他人手写。 传输是非三相的:搜索-代理的轨迹很长,代理状态会将图像相混合,链接引用,以及工具输出相交.

blocks.en: When exploring the world, human practitioners both use existing tools and fashion new ones when existing tools fall short ( Goodall, 1964 ; Beck, 1980 ; Tomasello, 1999 ) . We argue that a multimodal search agent should be equipped with the same capability. When existing tools fall short, the agent should organically fashion new ones from familiar parts, refining and reusing them across tasks. Currently, multimodal search agents only share the using half of this picture but conspicuously not the fashioning half. When their tool set fails, they ’let it go’ rather than enlarge and revise the toolbox. Moreover, humans do not blindly adopt every novel implementation they sketch. They verify it on test cases before adding it to the working library ( Schön, 1983 ) . An agent equipped to grow its tools must also be equipped to verify them.
blocks.zh: 在探索世界时,人类从业者既使用现有工具,也使用现有工具不足时的新工具(Goodall,1964;Beck,1980;Tomasello,1999)。 我们主张,多式联运搜索代理应配备同样的能力。 当现有工具不足时,代理人应当从熟悉的部分有机地设计出新的工具,在任务之间加以改进和再利用。 目前,多式联运搜索人员只分享这一图中的使用部分,但显然没有分享形成部分。 当工具设定失败时, 此外,人类不会盲目地采纳他们描绘的每一个新颖的落实. 他们通过测试案例进行核实,然后将其添加到工作图书馆(Schön,1983年)。 配有发展工具的代理人也必须配有核查工具。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce ToolSmith , an automatic tool-generation framework organized as four model-agnostic phases: 1) Trajectory Mining , 2) Reuse-or-Grow Decision , 3) Tool Generation , 4) Two-Gate Verification . We cluster the agent’s failed trajectories into capability gaps ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Andrychowicz et al., 2017 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , check each gap against a lean library of eight primitives to decide reuse versus generation, prompt a generator VLM to author new tools as Python source under structural and anti-hardcode constraints, and admit candidates only after sandboxed sanity and LLM static code-review gates.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了TolleSmith,这是一个自动工具生成框架,分为四个模型不可知阶段: (1) 轨迹采矿;(2) 重复使用或增长决定;(3) 工具生成;(4) 二地验证。 我们把毒剂失败的轨迹组合成能力差距(Shinn等,2023;Andrychowicz等,2017;Chen等,2025),对照由8个原始人组成的精选库来检查每个漏洞,以决定再利用与生成,促使一个发电机VLM在结构和反硬码限制下作为Python源编写出新工具,并且只有在沙箱的疗养和LLM静态代码审查门后才能录取候选人.

blocks.en: We evaluate ToolSmith across 3 in-domain multimodal search benchmarks (FVQA, InfoSeek, EncyclopedicVQA) and 10 out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge manner. When using the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model, admitted tools improve the base tool library by +2.20pp in-domain and +1.33pp out-of-domain tasks. Gains scale with backbone capacity, reaching +2.98pp out-of-domain on Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and a consistent uplift on GPT-5. We also utilize a comprehensive ablation study to demonstrate how different tool generation models and training samples affect the benchmark performance. Our code and data will be publicly available.
blocks.zh: 我们以VLM-as-judge的方式,评估3个域内多模式搜索基准(FVQA、InfoSeek、EncyclopedicVQA)和10个域外基准。 在使用Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct模型时,被接受的工具通过+2.20pp内域和+1.33pp外域任务改进了基础工具库. 有骨干能力的增益规模,在Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct上达到+2.98pp出领域,并持续提升到GPT-5上. 我们还利用一项综合开发研究,说明不同的工具生成模式和培训样本如何影响基准业绩。 我们的代码和数据将会公开。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work targets multimodal search, where a query is resolved by orchestrating reasoning, perception, and live web retrieval across many turns. A growing collection of benchmarks frames this task: MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) couples a multimodal query with a curated search engine; MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) adds provenance-aware verification; BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2026 ) and MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025 ) raise cross-modal information-seeking difficulty; VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) targets visual-native search; and RealX-Bench ( Hong et al., 2026a ) couples fine-grained perception with multi-hop retrieval. Beyond pure search, the landscape extends to embodied tasks that integrate web information with physical action ( Hong et al., 2026b ) . These tasks build on vision-language understanding, where models must ground fine-grained visual evidence ( You et al., 2022 ; Sun et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) and abstain when the visual context is insufficient ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Recent browsing agents tackle these benchmarks via hand-engineered tool inventories ( Geng et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Narayan et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning that teaches tool use and action selection ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) , or memory learned over a fixed inventory ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Hasegawa et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026b ) . Our contribution is orthogonal: rather than freeze the inventory, we generate it.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作目标是多模式搜索,其中一个查询通过在许多回合之间协调推理、感知和现场网络检索来解决。 越来越多的基准汇编规定了这一任务:MMSearch(Jiang等,2025年)与多模式查询搭配了可视化搜索引擎;MMSearch-Plus(Tao等,2026年)增加了对出处的识别;浏览Comp-VL(Geng等,2026年)和MM-BrowseComp(Li等,2025年)提高了跨模式信息搜索难度;VisBrowse-Bench(Zhang等,2026b年)的目标是可视化-内在搜索;RealX-Bench(Hong等,2026a)对夫妇进行了多平台检索。 除了纯搜索之外,该地貌还延伸到包含的任务,将网络信息与物理动作相融合(Hong等,2026b.). 这些任务以视觉语言理解为基础,模型必须打出精细的视觉证据(You等,2022;Sun等,2023;Wang等,2024;等),当视觉环境不足时弃权(刘等,2024. 近期浏览剂通过手工工具清查处理这些基准(Geng等,2026;Huang等,2026;Yao等,2026;Chen等,2026a;Wu等,2025;Narayan等,2025;周等,2026),监督细化或强化学习,教授工具使用和行动选择(Jiang等,2026a),或从固定清查中吸取的记忆(Xiao等,2025;Hasegawa等,2025;Jiang等,2026b)。 我们的贡献是正统的:我们不是冻结库存,而是生成库存。

blocks.en: Building on a lineage of LLM-orchestrated modular vision-language reasoning ( You et al., 2023 ) , our work is closely related to a recent line of methods in which the agent itself constructs new tools. GENOME ( Chen et al., 2024 ) grows a library of vision-module wrappers proposed by an LLM and validated on few-shot examples. CRAFT ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) creates and retrieves Python tools for math, table QA, and image classification. TOOLMAKER ( Wölflein et al., 2025 ) turns code repositories into LLM-callable utilities for general NLP. Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) grows an executable skill library for an open-ended Minecraft agent, with a parallel line of work ( Wang et al., 2025 ) carrying the idea to web agents via online programmatic skill induction. EvolveR ( Wu et al., ) distills past trajectories into textual principles that guide future behaviour, and WorldMind ( Ren et al., 2026 ) builds a symbolic world-knowledge repository from agent experience for physically-grounded action. Compared with these, we introduce the tool generation framework into the multimodal search domain.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作基于LLM-操控的模块化视觉语言推理(You等, 2023年)的分界线,与代理商自己构建新工具的一行方法密切相关。 GENOME(Chen等,2024年)生长了由LLM所提出并用几个镜头进行验证的视觉-模块包装器库. CRAFT (Yuan等, 2024) 为数学,表QA和图像分类创建并检索了Python工具. TOOLMAKER(Wölflein等,2025年)将代码存储器转换为通用NLP的LLM可调用公用事业. Voyager (Wang等,2023年)为可执行的Minecraft代理商开发了可执行技能库,并有平行的工作线(Wang等,2025年)通过在线程序技能上岗向网络代理商传递了这一想法. EvolveR (Wu等,.)将过去的轨迹提炼成指导未来行为的文字原理;而WorldMind (Ren等,2026年)则从代理经验中建立了一个象征性的世界知识库,用于实际操作. 与之相比,我们将工具生成框架引入了多模式搜索领域。

blocks.en: ToolSmith is organized as a four-phase pipeline (Figure 2 ): Phase 1 mines capability gaps (query patterns the base tools cannot handle) from the baseline agent’s failed trajectories. Phase 2 decides, per gap, whether to reuse an existing tool or escalate to generation. Phase 3 prompts a generator LLM to author the new tool as Python code. Phase 4 admits the candidate after verification gates. At inference time, a lightweight retrieval step selects relevant generated tools per query.

blocks.zh: 为了确保候选人的多样性,我们把每个能力差距嵌入其中,作为其问题、预测和黄金答案的集合,使用一个句子编码器\\ psi,然后在同位素相距上将聚合(平均连接)应用到C组。 每组有一名代表进入第2至第4阶段。

blocks.en: 3.2 Phase 2: Reuse-or-Grow Decision
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 第2阶段:重新使用或扩大决定

blocks.en: Phase 2 decides, for each capability gap, whether the current tool catalog already covers it or a new tool is needed. If ρ pre > τ pre \rho_{\text{pre}}>\tau_{\mathrm{pre}} , the gap is treated as covered by the best-matching tool and skipped; otherwise it is forwarded to Phase 3. TF–IDF suffices here because tool descriptions are short, the vocabulary is domain-specific (search, image, OCR, code), and we only need to detect obvious overlaps.

TF-IDF在这里就足够了,因为工具描述很短,词汇是专有域的(搜索,图像,OCR,代码),我们只需要检测出明显的重叠.

blocks.en: 3.3 Phase 3: Tool Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 第3阶段:工具生成

blocks.en: Phase 3 takes each gap that Phase 2 forwards and writes a new tool for it. We prompt a generator LLM G ϕ G_{\phi} to produce Python source code conditioned on the gap, the current catalog, a system prompt that specifies the tool-class interface and forbids dynamic execution / unsanctioned I/O / hard-coded answers, and a handful of example tools the generator can imitate (full prompts and examples in Appendix F ). The output is a candidate c c comprising Python source, a typed schema, and a short natural-language description, which is then forwarded to Phase 4 for verification. Representative code listings of admitted, failed, and filtered candidates appear in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 第3阶段取出第2阶段前进的每个缺口,并为它写出一个新的工具. 我们激励一个生成器 LLM G QQQPhi} 生成 Python 源代码, 以空隙为条件, 当前目录, 一个系统提示, 指定工具类接口, 并禁止动态执行 / 未批准 I/O / 硬编码的答案, 还有少数实例工具 , 生成器可以模仿( 附录 F 中的全部提示和示例 ) 。 输出为候选cc由Python source,一个打入的schema,以及一个简短的自然语言描述组成,然后被传送到第四阶段进行验证. 被接纳、失败和被过滤的候选人的代表代码列表载于附录G。

blocks.en: 3.4 Phase 4: Verification and Inference
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 第4阶段:核查和推断

blocks.en: A candidate is admitted only if it passes both verification gates followed by a redundancy check against the existing catalog. We run the gates in order of increasing computational cost: Gate 1 is a cheap static check, so candidates that fail it are dropped before we pay for Gate 2’s LLM critic.
blocks.zh: 只有候选人通过两个核查门,然后对照现有目录进行冗余检查,才被接纳。 我们运行大门是为了增加计算成本:1号门是一种廉价的静态检查,因此失败的候选人在支付2号门的LLM评论员之前就被丢弃了.

blocks.en: The candidate’s source is parsed and scanned for dynamic-execution and dangerous-I/O patterns, then executed once on a minimal dummy input under a ten-second wall-clock budget. Anything that violates the static checks or errors at runtime is rejected.
blocks.zh: 候选人的来源被解析和扫描,以了解动态执行和危险-I/O模式,然后在10秒长的预算下,在最低限度的假输入上执行一次。 凡违反静态检查或运行时出错的,一律拒绝.

blocks.en: An LLM critic scores the candidate on four 0–5 axes (parametric usage, description abstractness, edge-case handling, and task alignment) and admits it only when the mean score is at least μ min \mu_{\min} and the minimum across axes is at least a min a_{\min} . The critic may use a different model from the generator; tools with overly narrow descriptions or missing error handling are caught here.
blocks.zh: LLM评论家在4个0–5轴(参数用法,描述抽象度,边框处理和任务对接)上给候选人评分,并承认只有在平均分数至少为μ min\mu_{\min}且跨轴的最小分数至少为一分 a_{\min}时才承认. 评论家可能使用与生成器不同的模型;描述过窄或缺失出错处理的工具在这里被捕获.

blocks.en: When either gate rejects a candidate, we re-prompt G ϕ G_{\phi} with a short natural-language summary of which gate failed and why, up to a per-candidate budget A A . Empirically, most retries either pass on the second attempt or remain wrong for the same reason, so A A is capped at a small constant.
blocks.zh: 当任一门拒绝候选人时,我们用一个简短的自然语言摘要重新提出G-Q-G-Phi}其中哪个门失败了,为什么,直到每个候选人的预算A。 经验中,大多数回想要么通过第二次尝试,要么出于同样的原因继续错误,因此A被封入了小常数.

blocks.en: A candidate that survives both gates is then compared against every existing tool by TF–IDF cosine similarity over descriptions (the same construction as Eq. 1 , with a stricter threshold τ post \tau_{\mathrm{post}} ). Only candidates whose closest match falls below τ post \tau_{\mathrm{post}} are admitted to the next-round catalog 𝒯 t + 1 \mathcal{T}_{t+1} ; redundant duplicates are dropped.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Base Tool Library
blocks.zh: 4.1 基本工具库

blocks.en: Our base library consists of eight primitive tools grouped into three capability categories: Search , Vision , and Code Execution . The search tools are powered by the Serper API 1 1 1 https://serper.dev/ ; the visual tools wrap SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) , PaddleOCR-VL ( Cui et al., 2025 ) , and Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) as their underlying models. Table 1 lists the eight tools with a one-line description each. More details can be found at Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们的基地库由8个原始工具组成,分为三个能力类别:搜索、视觉和代码执行。 搜索工具由Serper API 1 1 1 https://serper.dev/提供动力;可视化工具包装了SAM3(Carion等,2026年),PaddleOCR-VL(Cui等,2025年),深度Anything 3(Lin等,2025年)作为其基本模型. 表1列出了八个工具,每个工具都有一行描述. 详见附录C。

blocks.en: Table 1: Base library of eight primitive tools, grouped by capability. Detailed schemas and tool documentation appear in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 表1:按能力分类的八种原始工具的基础库. 详细的计划和工具文件载于附录C。

blocks.en: These eight span the major primitive categories a multimodal search agent commonly relies on, providing a broad foundation on top of which our pipeline grows additional, task-specific tools.
blocks.zh: 这八种方法跨越了一种多式联运搜索代理商通常依赖的主要原始类别,提供了广泛的基础,在此之上,我们的管道增加了更多的针对具体任务的工具。

blocks.en: 4.2 Tool-Generation Training Pool
blocks.zh: 4.2 工具包培训库

blocks.en: We collect trajectories from the train or val splits of three knowledge-intensive multimodal search datasets: FVQA ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , InfoSeek ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , and EncyclopedicVQA ( Mensink et al., 2023 ) . The held-out test splits of the same three datasets serve as our in-domain (ID) evaluation in Section 4.3 , providing a within-distribution measure of whether the generated tools address the failure modes they were designed for. No example from any out-of-domain benchmark enters tool generation. We defer per-dataset sampling sizes and split choices to Appendix F.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们收集三个知识密集型多模式搜索数据集的列车或Val分出轨迹:FVQA(Wu等,2025年),InfoSeek(Chen等,2023年)和EncyclopedicVQA (Mensink等,2023). 同一三个数据集的搁置测试拆分作为我们第4.3节的域内(ID)评价,提供了对生成的工具是否针对其设计的故障模式进行内部分配的尺度. 没有来自任何域外基准的例子进入工具生成. 我们把每个数据集的采样大小和分开选择推迟到附录F.1。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价基准

blocks.en: We evaluate ToolSmith along two axes: in-domain (ID) performance on the held-out test splits of the three datasets we used to mine capability gaps during training, and out-of-domain (OOD) transfer to ten public multimodal search benchmarks unseen during tool generation. Per-benchmark sample counts are summarized in Table 8 , and full per-benchmark descriptions are deferred to Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们沿着两个轴线评估工具系统(OilSmith):我们用来在培训期间弥补能力差距的三套数据集的预留测试(ID)的内置性能,以及将域外(OOD)转移到工具生成期间所未见的十项公共多模式搜索基准。 表8汇总了每个基准点的样本数,并将每个基准点的完整描述推迟到附录B.1。

blocks.en: ID evaluation uses the held-out test splits of FVQA ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , InfoSeek ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , and EncyclopedicVQA ( Mensink et al., 2023 ) . Because the training pool from which we mine capability gaps comes from the training splits of these same datasets, the test splits provide a within-distribution measure of how well the generated tools address the failure modes they were designed for. We give full per-benchmark descriptions in Appendix B.1.1 .
blocks.zh: ID评价采用FVQA(Wu等,2025年),InfoSeek(Chen等,2023年)和EncyclopedicVQA的搁置测试分出. (Mensink等,2023). 由于我们地雷能力缺口的训练池来自这些相同数据集的训练分出,因此测试分出提供一个内部分配的尺度,衡量生成的工具如何妥善地处理它们设计的故障模式。 我们在附录B.1.1中提供了每个基准的完整说明。

blocks.en: OOD evaluation uses ten public multimodal information-seeking benchmarks: MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025 ) , SimpleVQA ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) , HLE-VL ( Phan et al., 2025 ) , LiveVQA ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2026 ) , RealX-Bench ( Hong et al., 2026a ) , VDR-Bench ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . None of these share data with the training pool. For benchmarks that mix text-only and image-grounded items we restrict evaluation to the multimodal subset (queries carrying at least one image), so the reported counts are smaller than the full-benchmark totals. Appendix B.1.2 provides per-benchmark descriptions.
blocks.zh: OO评估采用10项公开的多模式信息搜索基准: MM-BrowseComp (Li等人,2025年),简易VQA (Cheng等,2025年),MMSearch (Jiang等,2025年),MMSearch-Plus (Tao等,2026年),HLE-VL (Phan等,2025年),LiveVQA (Fu等,2026年),瀏覽comp-VL (Geng等,2026年),RealX-Bench (Hong等,2026a),VDR-Bench (Huang等,2026年),和VisBrowse-Bench (Zhang等,2026b.). 没有一个与培训人才库共享数据。 对于将文本和图像组合在一起的基准,我们仅限于对多模式子集(至少包含一个图像的点数)进行评价,因此所报告的计数小于全部基准总数。 附录B.1.2提供了每个基准的说明。

blocks.en: Final-answer correctness is judged by a VLM-as-a-Judge prompted with GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) , following ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) ; the prompt and a discussion of retrieval-shortcut concerns are in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 最后的答案正确性由一位由GPT-4o(Hurst等人,2024年)召集的VLM-as-a-法官判断,随后(Huang等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年a年),对检索问题的及时和讨论载于附录B.2。

blocks.en: 4.4 Models and Implementation
blocks.zh: 4.4 模式和实施

blocks.en: We consider three open-sourced models, including Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, and Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, since all of them can cover different model sizes (8B vs 32B) and model variants (Instruct vs Thinking). For proprietory models, we consider GPT-5 (gpt-5-2025-08-07). We sample at temperature 0.3 0.3 with top- p p 0.95 0.95 , allow up to fifteen tool-calling iterations per query, and cap context at 120K tokens; full hyperparameters are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们考虑三种开源模型,包括: Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct (Bai等,2025年), Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking, 和 Qune3-VL-32B-Instruct, 因为它们都可以覆盖不同的模型大小(8B vs 32B)和模型变体(Instruct vs Thinking). 对于专有型号,我们认为是GPT-5(gpt-5-2025-08-07). 我们用0.3 0.3 的温度进行取样,上面为0.95 0.95 第0.95页,每次查询最多可进行15次工具调用迭代,并用120K 令牌进行接合;完整的超参数载于附录E。

blocks.en: Because the search APIs, the agent’s tool-routing decisions, and the LLM judge are all stochastic, every reported number is the mean of three independent runs.
blocks.zh: 因为搜索API,代理的工具路线决定,以及LLM法官都是有花样的,所以每个被报道的数字都是三个独立运行的平均值.

blocks.en: 5 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5 主要结果

blocks.en: Tables 2 and 3 report headline accuracy on the in-domain (ID) and out-of-domain (OOD) benchmarks under three settings per inference backbone: Direct Inference (no tools), Agent Workflow w/ Base Tools (the eight-primitive base library), and Agent Workflow w/ Base and ToolSmith (GPT-5) (the base library plus tools admitted by ToolSmith when GPT-5 is fixed as the generator). 2 2 2 Inference rows for GPT-5 here are systematically lower-bounded by privacy-driven refusals on identity-related queries; see Appendix B.4 .
blocks.zh: 表2和表3报告每个推论主干线下三个设置下的域内(ID)和域外(OOD)基准头条准确性: 直接推论(无工具), Agent Workflow w/ Base Tools (八原基库), Agent Workflow w/ Base and ToolSmith (GPT-5) (GPT-5被固定为生成器时,ToolsSmith所承认的基础库外加工具). 2 2 此处GPT-5的推论行由隐私驱动的对身份相关查询的拒绝而系统地降低;见附录B.4。

blocks.en: The eight base primitives alone lift Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by roughly + 25 +25 pp on ID and + 10 +10 pp on OOD over Direct Inference , with 32B and GPT-5 showing comparably large jumps; multimodal search is clearly a tool-driven task. Adding the ToolSmith -generated tools on top of the base library yields further consistent gains of one to three points on both ID and OOD across all three inference backbones, and the gains are pervasive per-benchmark: 32B and GPT-5 improve on every OOD benchmark and 8B improves on eight of the ten, with the remaining two essentially flat.
blocks.zh: 8个基底原始人单独举起Qwen3-VL-8B-指示由ID上大约+25+25pp和OOD上大约+10+10pp在直接推论上,有32B和GPT-5显示相仿大的跳跃;多模式搜索显然是由工具驱动的任务. 在基础库上方添加工具Smith,使所有三个推论主干线的ID和OD都得到1至3分的进一步一致收益,收益是普遍的:32B和GPT-5改进了每个OD基准,8B改进了10个中的8个,其余两个基本平平.

blocks.en: The average gain peaks at 32B ( + 2.32 +2.32 pp across ID and OOD), with GPT-5 ( + 1.72 +1.72 pp) and 8B ( + 1.77 +1.77 pp) close behind for different reasons: GPT-5’s smaller gain partly reflects its privacy-refusal floor (Appendix B.4 ); 8B’s reflects the long-context tool-selection cost of an enlarged toolbox. The Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking variant modestly outperforms Instruct under Direct Inference but takes more than 5 × 5\times the per-query latency inside the full agent workflow, so we standardize on Instruct as the default deployed agent for all subsequent results, ablations, and analyses.

blocks.en: 6 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 6 阅读研究

blocks.en: The inference-backbone axis is already covered by the main results (Section 5 ), which sweep Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, 32B-Instruct, 8B-Thinking, and GPT-5 with a fixed GPT-5 tool generator. This section ablates the remaining design choices: which model authors new tools, whose trajectories the pipeline mines, and how the cluster-count knob shapes the resulting tool bank. Because each ablation requires re-running Phases 1–4 of the pipeline end-to-end on the full training pool, we restrict every sweep below to one representative ID benchmark (FVQA) and one representative OOD benchmark (MMSearch) to keep the compute budget tractable.
blocks.zh: 推论-后骨轴已经被主要结果所覆盖(第5节),它横扫了Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct,32B-Instruct,8B-Thinking,并用固定的GPT-5工具生成器. 本节放弃了其余的设计选择:由哪个模型编写出新的工具,由哪个模型编写管道矿井的轨迹,以及集群计数克诺布如何塑造由此产生的工具库. 因为每次膨胀都需要在全训练池上重新运行管道端到端的1至4阶段,所以我们把下方的每次扫描都限制在一个具有代表性的ID基准(FVQA)和一个具有代表性的OOD基准(MMSearch)上,以保持计算预算的可操作性.

blocks.en: 6.1 Tool-Generation Model
blocks.zh: 6.1 工具生成模型

blocks.en: The main results (Section 5 ) sweep the inference backbone with a fixed GPT-5 generator; here we instead vary the tool-generation model over (GPT-5, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct), and for each generator evaluate the resulting tool bank on the same three inference backbones. We restrict the sweep to one representative ID benchmark (FVQA) and one representative OOD benchmark (MMSearch) to keep the cost contained, and treat the resulting numbers as an illustrative finding rather than a statistical claim. Generation-process statistics (pass rates, dedup, cost) for the three generators are reported in Appendix F.2 .
blocks.zh: 主要结果(第5节)用固定的GPT-5生成器来扫荡推论主干线;在此我们更改了工具生成模型(GPT-5,Qune3-VL-32B-Instruct,Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct),对于每个生成器,则在同一个三个推论主干线上评价所生成的工具库. 我们仅限于一个有代表性的ID基准(FVQA)和一个有代表性的OOD基准(MMSearch)来控制成本,并将由此产生的数字视为一个说明性结论,而不是一个统计索赔。 附录F.2报告了三台发电机的生成过程统计(通过率、停产率、成本)。

blocks.en: Reading the matrix by column (fix the consumer, vary the generator), accuracy rises monotonically with generator strength on both benchmarks, for every consumer, with no exceptions. A stronger generator simply produces better tools; the gain is largest when the consumer is weakest (the 8B-Instruct consumer picks up roughly six to seven points going from an 8B to a GPT-5 generator, versus only about two points for the GPT-5 consumer). Conversely, pairing the GPT-5 consumer with an 8B generator loses about two points relative to the all-GPT-5 cell. The take-away is that the choice of generator dominates the design: invest compute in the strongest available generator, and let the deployed agent scale separately.

blocks.en: 6.2 Trajectory-Mining Source Model
blocks.zh: 6.2 轨迹-矿源模型

blocks.en: We additionally vary the model whose trajectories are mined in Phase 1, holding the tool generator at GPT-5 and the consumer at Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. A weak miner surfaces many simple, frequent gaps; a strong miner produces fewer but more specialized failures. The question is whether the 8B consumer prefers tools mined from its own failures or from a stronger model’s.

blocks.en: 7 Analysis
blocks.zh: 7 分析

blocks.en: 7.1 Overhead
blocks.zh: 7.1 间接费用

blocks.en: Both the one-time tool-generation cost and the per-query inference overhead of ToolSmith are manageable in practice. Due to space, we defer the full token, dollar, wall-clock, and per-query breakdown to Appendix H .

blocks.en: 7.2 New-Tool Adoption
blocks.zh: 7.2 新工具收养

blocks.en: Table 7 reports how often the agent invokes generated tools across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks.

blocks.en: On in-domain benchmarks, generated tools account for 27% of all tool calls, and 41% of samples invoke at least one, confirming that the agent actively selects generated tools when the query matches their capability. On out-of-domain benchmarks, adoption drops to 15% of calls and 16% of samples, which is expected since the tools were mined from in-domain failures. Nevertheless, the non-trivial OOD adoption indicates that some generated tools generalize beyond their training distribution.

blocks.en: 7.3 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 7.3 定性分析

blocks.en: We examine the patterns behind gained and lost samples; four illustrated case studies appear in Figures 3 – 6 (Appendix I ), and code-level tool examples in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 我们审查得失样本背后的规律;图3-6(附录一)和附录G的编码级工具实例中列出了四个说明性案例研究。

blocks.en: The dominant pattern is that generated tools enforce a perceive-then-query pipeline that the base agent skips. With only base primitives, the agent often jumps to text search without first identifying the visual entity. Generated tools chain reverse-image search with structured KB lookup in a single call, forcing the correct order. For example, on “What year did he give $50M to create the Hastings Initiative?” (Figure 3 ), the base agent searches without identifying Reed Hastings and mis-attributes the donation to Eric Schmidt; the generated tool resolves the person first, after which a single text search returns the correct year.
blocks.zh: 主要的规律是,生成的工具可以执行一个被底质跳过、感知到的平滑管。 只有基础原始语,代理经常会跳到文本搜索中而不首先识别视觉实体. 生成工具链反向图像搜索,在单个呼叫中进行结构化的KB搜索,强制正确的顺序. 例如,关于“他为创建黑斯廷斯倡议提供了5万美元?” (图3),基干代理搜索时未识别出里德·黑斯廷斯,而将捐赠错误地分配给了埃里克·施密特;生成的工具首先解决了人物,之后一个文本搜索返回正确的年份.

blocks.en: Among the lost samples, failures concentrate on a small number of tools that return incorrect information. Other losses stem from visual mis-identification or from the agent trusting a generated tool’s output over a correct result it had already obtained from a base tool. Appendix G walks through one successful tool, one runtime-failing tool, and one tool filtered out by Gate 2 in code-level detail.
blocks.zh: 在丢失的样本中,失败集中在少数返回不正确信息的工具上. 其他损失来自视觉识别错误,或代理人相信生成的工具的输出与它已经从一个基本工具获得的正确结果有关。 附 录 G行走通过一个成功的工具,一个跑出时间飞出的工具,以及一个被Gate 2过滤出代码级细节的工具.

blocks.en: The in-domain benchmarks, where adoption is highest (41%), show consistent accuracy improvements, while the lower-adoption OOD benchmarks show smaller or neutral changes, suggesting that the accuracy gains are driven by actual tool use rather than incidental prompt differences.
blocks.zh: 采用率最高(41%)的域内基准显示一致的准确性提高,采用率较低的OOD基准显示较小或中性的变化,这表明准确性提高是由实际工具使用而不是偶然的即时差异驱动的.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ToolSmith , an automatic, model-agnostic tool-generation framework for multimodal search agents. Starting from an eight-primitive base tool library, it mines trajectories on a training pool, generates new tools under our proposed ToolSmith framework. Across three in-domain and ten out-of-domain benchmarks, admitted tools improve on top of the base tool library on every benchmark, and gains persist across different inference models, and tool-generation models. Furthermore, we conduct more in-depth analysis on tool generation, tool use, and error samples. ToolSmith is a step toward multimodal search agents that extend their own capabilities with minimal human curation.
blocks.zh: 我们为多式联运搜索代理商推出了一个自动、模型不可知的工具生成框架。 它从一个八大基础工具库开始,在训练池上埋设出轨迹,根据我们拟议的工具史密斯框架产生出新的工具。 在所有三项内域基准和十项外域基准中,在基准工具库之上,被认可工具在每个基准上都有改进,不同推论模型和工具生成模型的得益持续存在。 此外,我们对工具生成、工具使用和出错样本进行更深入的分析。 ToolSmith是向多式联运搜索人员迈出的一步,这些搜索人员以最低限度的人文教育来扩展自己的能力。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: ToolSmith does not include tools that themselves generate images, such as those introduced by Gen-Searcher ( Feng et al., 2026 ) and Unify-Agent ( Chen et al., 2026b ) ; we plan to leave the generative part, together with its safety controls ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , to future work. We have also not yet utilized a code-specialized LLM as the tool-generator backbone, and we believe a stronger code model would further improve the quality of admitted tools and downstream accuracy. Finally, since the live search APIs and proprietary models change with time, exact numerical reproduction may drift. We pin model snapshots and archive trajectories to partially mitigate this, but building a fully replicable environment for search agents remains worth pursuing in the future.
blocks.zh: ToolSmith不包括自己生成图像的工具,例如由Gen-Searcher(Feng等,2026年)和Unify-Agent(Chen等,2026年b;我们计划将基因部分连同其安全控制(Zhang等,2026年a)留给未来工作. 我们还尚未使用编码专用LLM作为工具生成器的中枢,我们认为更强大的代码模型会进一步提高被认可工具的质量和下游准确度. 最后,由于活搜索API和专有模型随时间而变化,准确的数字复制可能会漂移. 我们定下模型快照和档案轨迹 来部分缓解这种情况, 但是为搜索人员建立一个完全可以复制的环境 在未来仍然值得追求。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: All datasets we use are publicly released for research and we do not redistribute them. Generated code runs in a process-level sandbox with an AST allow-list and execution timeout, sufficient to block accidental misuse. We cannot control the commercial search APIs and proprietary models. But we have ensured that all of our uses are legal and appropriate. The potential risk comes from the external APIs, which may return harmful content. We have verified and tried our best to mitigate this risk.
blocks.zh: 我们使用的所有数据集都公开供研究使用,我们不重新分配。 生成的代码在一个进程级沙盒中运行,带有AST允许列表和执行超时,足以阻止意外误用. 我们不能控制商业搜索API和专有型号. 但我们确保了我们的所有用途都是合法和适当的。 潜在的风险来自外部的API,这些API可能会返回有害的内容. 我们已经核实并尽力减轻这一风险。

blocks.en: A fact-based VQA dataset ( Wu et al., 2025 ) that pairs images with questions whose answers require commonsense or world-knowledge facts not directly observable in the image. We evaluate on the official test split of 1800 samples, and use the 3132 search-required samples from the train split for tool generation.
blocks.zh: 一个基于事实的VQA数据集(Wu等,2025年),将图像与答案需要常识或世界知识的事实在图像中无法直接观察到的问题相配. 我们评价1800个样本的官方测试分拆,并使用从列车分出所需的3132个搜索样本来生成工具.

blocks.en: A visual information-seeking benchmark ( Chen et al., 2023 ) of fine-grained questions about entities depicted in images (e.g., species, models, landmarks). We use the val split for tool generation and test split for inference.
blocks.zh: 一个视觉信息搜索基准(Chen等,2023年),关于图像所描绘的实体(如物种,模型,地标等)的细微问题. 我们使用val分数来生成工具,测试分数来推断.

blocks.en: A benchmark ( Mensink et al., 2023 ) of questions about detailed properties of fine-grained categories. We evaluate on the test split and use val split for tool generation.
blocks.zh: 关于细纹类详细属性问题的基准(Mensink等,2023年). 我们评估测试的分数,并使用val分数来生成工具.

blocks.en: B.1.2 Out-of-Domain Benchmarks
blocks.zh: B.1.2 外地基准

blocks.en: A multimodal search benchmark ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) of 300 manually curated questions across 14 subfields, designed to assess large multimodal models as multimodal search engines. We evaluate on the End-to-End sub-task, which requires the agent to perform query understanding, retrieval, and answering in a single pipeline. To align with other works for fair comparison, we only use multimodal subset, which contains 171 samples.
blocks.zh: 跨14个分域的300个人工解答问题的多式联运搜索基准(Jiang等,2025年),旨在评估大型多式联运模式作为多式联运搜索引擎。 我们评价端到端子任务,它要求代理在单一的管道中进行查询理解,检索和回答. 为了与公平比较的其他作品保持一致,我们只使用含有171个样本的多式子集.

blocks.en: A harder, provenance-aware extension ( Tao et al., 2026 ) that emphasizes localized visual reasoning, verification under noisy or conflicting retrieval, and multi-step text–image search; each item provides 1–5 images and one or more valid answers. We use 311 full set for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 更难的,来源意识的扩展(Tao等,2026年),强调局部视觉推理,在吵闹或相冲突的检索下进行验证,以及多步骤的文本-图像搜索;每个项目提供1–5个图像和一个或多个有效的答案. 我们使用311全集进行评估。

blocks.en: The vision–language extension of BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) introduced by WebWatcher ( Geng et al., 2026 ) , with cross-modal information-seeking questions spanning entertainment, humanities, technology, natural science, and other domains. We use all 399 samples for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 由WebWatcher(Geng等,2026年)介绍的浏览孔通(Wei等,2025年)的愿景-语言扩展,包括跨模式的信息搜索问题,涵盖娱乐、人文、技术、自然科学等领域。 我们使用所有399个样本进行评估。

blocks.en: Hand-crafted multimodal browsing questions ( Li et al., 2025 ) across several sub-tasks, where the answer-relevant content is hard to find. There are two versions of MM-BrowseComp. We use the newest version, which has 243 multimodal tasks.
blocks.zh: 手工多式浏览问题 (Li等,2025年)跨出多个子任务,其中答案相关内容难以找到. MM-BrowseComp有两个版本. 我们使用最新版本,它有243个多式联运任务。

blocks.en: A multimodal factuality benchmark ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) of short, knowledge-bound questions with timeless reference answers. Following WebWatcher’s setting, we evaluate on the English subset containing 300 multimodal tasks.
blocks.zh: 多式联运实事求是基准(Cheng等,2025年),包含短而有知识约束的问题,并附有永恒的参考答案. 根据WebWatcher的设定,我们评价包含300个多式联运任务的英文子集。

blocks.en: A benchmark of visual-native search instances ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) that require cross-validation of multimodal evidence via interleaved text–image retrieval and joint reasoning, including cases where the answer is not present in any text snippet. We use the full 169 samples to evaluate.
blocks.zh: 视觉-内在搜索案例的基准(Zhang等,2026b)要求通过互出文本-图像检索和联合推理交叉验证多式证据,包括任何文本片断中都没有答案的情况。 我们用169个样本来评估

blocks.en: The multimodal subset of Humanity’s Last Exam ( Phan et al., 2025 ) , drawn from frontier-knowledge questions across mathematics, the natural sciences, and the humanities.
blocks.zh: 由数学、自然科学和人文科学前沿知识问题组成的人类最后考试(Phan等人,2025年)的多模式子集。

blocks.en: A live visual knowledge-seeking benchmark ( Fu et al., 2026 ) drawing from recent news, video platforms, and academic publications, designed for the seeking-and-updating regime. We follow WebWatcher’s setting and use 300 samples from LiveVQA to evaluate.
blocks.zh: 取自近期新闻,视频平台和学术出版物的现场视觉知识搜索基准(Fu等,2026年),为寻找与更新制度所设计. 我们遵循WebWatcher的设定,

blocks.en: Introduced by DeepEyesV2 ( Hong et al., 2026a ) ; expert-verified instances that require integrating fine-grained visual perception, dynamic multi-hop web retrieval, and multi-step logical reasoning. This benchmark contains perception and search types, which make it easy to check the performance improvement coming from visual tools and search tools.
blocks.zh: 由DeepEyesV2(Hong等,2026a)所引入;需要整合精致视觉感知,动态多跳网络检索,多步逻辑推理的专家验证实例. 这个基准包含感知和搜索类型,这使得检查来自视觉工具和搜索工具的性能改进变得容易.

blocks.en: The benchmark released alongside Vision-DeepResearch ( Huang et al., 2026 ) : long-horizon multimodal deep-research instances that interleave many reasoning turns with hundreds of search-engine interactions, designed to evaluate sustained multi-step browsing under heavy real-world noise.
blocks.zh: 与"Vision-Deep Reference"一并发布的基准(黄克华等,2026年) :由数百个搜索-引擎交互,使许多推理相互交织的长相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多相多

blocks.en: B.2 LLM Judge Prompt and Retrieval-Shortcut Check
blocks.zh: B.2 LLM 法官 即时和检索-速记检查

blocks.en: Across all ID and OOD benchmarks, we did not observe cases in which the search tools surface the gold answer verbatim from indexed pages. Accuracy therefore reflects the agent’s multi-step reasoning over evidence rather than a retrieval shortcut.
blocks.zh: 在所有ID和OOD基准中,我们没有看到搜索工具从索引页面中逐字显示黄金答案的情况。 因此,准确性反映了代理人对证据的多步骤推理,而不是检索捷径。

blocks.en: To align with recent multimodal deep-research work ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , we adopt the same LLM judge as Vision-DeepResearch ( Huang et al., 2026 ) and use GPT-4o as the judge model, applying the prompt below uniformly across all benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了配合最近的多模式深入研究工作(Chen等,2026a),我们采用了与Vision-DeepReference(Huang等,2026年)相同的LLM法官,并将GPT-4o作为法官模式,在所有基准中统一应用以下的提示.

blocks.en: LLM Judge Prompt You are an impartial judge evaluating whether a deep research report contains the correct answer. [Question] {question} [Correct Answer] {correct_answer} [Deep Research Report] {response} Task: Determine if the deep research report contains the correct answer anywhere in its content. Instructions: 1. Read through the entire research report carefully 2. Look for the correct answer anywhere in the report (it may be embedded in paragraphs, tables, or sections) 3. Check if the information in the report is consistent with the correct answer 4. The answer does NOT need to be in a specific format or labelled as “final answer” 5. Provide your reasoning 6. Answer with “yes” if the report contains the correct answer, “no” if it doesn’t or contradicts it Output format: correct: [yes/no] reasoning: [your explanation]
blocks.zh: LLM 语言 法官即时 你是一个公正的法官,评估一份深入的调查报告是否包含正确的答案。 [问][问]. [校正接 {正确接 } [深度研究报告]{答复} 任务:确定深入研究报告的内容是否包含正确答案。 说明: 1.认真阅读整份研究报告. 2. 联合国 查找报告中任何地方的正确答案(可能嵌入到段落、表格或章节中) 3. 检查报告中的资料是否与正确答复一致 4. 答复不必以具体格式提出或标为 " 最后答复 " 。 5. 提供你的推理 6. 如果报告载有正确答案,用 " 有 " 回答,如果报告没有或与之相矛盾,用 " 有 " 回答。

blocks.en: B.3 Performance Variance
blocks.zh: B.3 业绩差异

blocks.en: Because the agent issues live search calls and the randomness exists in LLM generation, repeated evaluations of the same configuration show run-to-run variance. For the result numbers in Section 5 , we report the average of three independent runs.
blocks.zh: 由于代理发布直播搜索呼叫,且随机性存在于LLM生成中,因此重复评价同一配置显示的运行到运行差异. 关于第5节的结果数字,我们报告平均有三次独立运行。

blocks.en: B.4 Refusals on Identity Queries
blocks.zh: B.4 拒绝身份查询

blocks.en: Some of our evaluation benchmarks contain queries that reference a real person, such as “who is the person in this photograph,” “what is the affiliation of this researcher”. Proprietary models are increasingly trained to decline such queries under their privacy and identification policies, even when the gold answer is a public-figure fact already widely indexed on the open web. We observe this from GPT-5 in our setting, which returns a refusal in place of an answer, and the judge will count the refusal as incorrect. Therefore, in some of the benchmarks, the GPT-5 performance is lower than the Qwen3-VL-32B model or Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model.
blocks.zh: 我们的一些评估基准包含一些查询,其中提到一个真实的人,例如“这张照片中的人是谁”,“这个研究人员的归属是什么”。 专有模式越来越多地受到训练,以根据隐私和身份识别政策拒绝此类查询,即使金子答案是公众人物的事实,在公开网站上已经广泛索引. 我们从GPT-5中看到这一点,这回击拒绝代替答案,法官会认为拒绝是不正确的。 因此,在一些基准中,GPT-5的性能低于Quen3-VL-32B型或Quen3-VL-8B-指令型.

blocks.en: Appendix C Base Tools
blocks.zh: 附录C 基本工具

blocks.en: Below we give the detailed documentation for each of the eight base tools introduced in Section 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 下面我们详细介绍第4.1节提出的八种基本工具中的每一种。

blocks.en: C.1 Search Tools
blocks.zh: C.1 搜索工具

blocks.en: All three search tools route HTTP queries through the Serper API 3 3 3 https://serper.dev/ and post-process the raw payload with a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model as the VLM summarizer. The summarizer runs at decoding temperature 0 0 with a 4096 4096 -token output cap, and each call retrieves the top 10 10 raw results before reranking and summarization.
blocks.zh: 所有三种搜索工具都通过Serper API 3 3 3 https://serper.dev/进行查询,并以Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct模型作为VLM摘要处理原始有效载荷后. 汇总器运行于解码温度0:0,并有4096 4096-token输出盖,每次调用都会在重新排位和归纳前检索出前十名生结果.

blocks.en: Search the web with intelligent query routing and VLM summarization. Given a text query, the tool automatically classifies the query intent and routes it to the most appropriate Serper endpoint, which has general web, news, academic papers, images, maps, local places, shopping, or patents types, and returns a coherent summary of the top- 10 10 raw results with inline citations [1], [2], … followed by a citations block of source titles and URLs. This format supports multi-round search: the agent can read the summary for quick understanding and then visit specific cited URLs through Webpage Visit. The summarizer prompt is shown in C.1 .
blocks.zh: 以智能查询路由和VLM summarization搜索网络. 在文本查询中,该工具会自动将查询意图分类,并将它通向最合适的Serper端点,该端点具有一般的网页,新闻,学术论文,图像,地图,局部地盘,购物,或专利类型,并返回一个连贯的十大原始结果摘要,并带有线性引用[1],[2],.后是源标题和URL的引用块. 这种格式支持多回合搜索:代理可以读取摘要以快速理解,然后通过网页访问访问访问特定引用的URL. 总结提示以 C.1 显示 。

blocks.en: Text Search summarizer prompt (abridged) You are a research summarizer. Given raw web search results and a user query, do exactly three things: 1. RERANK the numbered organic results by how directly each helps answer the query. 2. KEEP at most K K most useful results; emit their original 1-based ranks as kept_indices . If none help, emit kept_indices: [] . 3. SUMMARIZE the query-relevant facts from the FULL set of raw results into a concise 3–5 sentence prose paragraph; include named entities, numbers, and dates verbatim. Knowledge-graph, answer-box, and top-stories blocks are ineligible for kept_indices but their facts should still surface in summary . Output STRICT JSON with the schema {kept_indices, summary, no_results_justification, suggested_queries, suggested_next_actions} ; when no result is useful, populate the justification and propose alternative queries or downstream tool calls.
blocks.zh: 文本搜索摘要提示( 缩写) 你是一个研究总结。 根据原始网页搜索结果和用户查询,做三件事: 1. 重新列出编号的有机结果,按每个结果如何直接帮助回答询问。 2. 最多保持K K最有用的结果;将其原有的1个等级作为保留-indices。 如果没有帮助,就发出保留_indices: []. 3. 将FLL系列原始结果中与查询有关的事实归纳为简洁的3至5句旁白段;包括点名的实体、数字和逐字日期。 知识图、答题框和顶层故事块没有资格保留_indices, 输出 STRICT JSON 与 { kept_indices, sequality, no_results_definition, adoptional_queries, protest_ next_actions} ; 当结果无益时, 输入理由并提议替代查询或下游工具呼叫 。

blocks.en: RERANK the numbered organic results by how directly each helps answer the query.
blocks.zh: 将编号的有机结果按每个结果如何直接帮助回答查询来排列。

blocks.en: KEEP at most K K most useful results; emit their original 1-based ranks as kept_indices . If none help, emit kept_indices: [] .
blocks.zh: KKEE 最多为 K K 最有用的结果; 将其最初的 1 级排出 。 如果没有帮助,就发出保留_indices: [].

blocks.en: SUMMARIZE the query-relevant facts from the FULL set of raw results into a concise 3–5 sentence prose paragraph; include named entities, numbers, and dates verbatim.
blocks.zh: 概况 (b) 包括点名的实体、数字和逐字日期。

blocks.en: Identify the objects, landmarks, artwork, text, products, plants, animals, and other entities depicted in an image, using Serper’s reverse-image-search (Google Lens) endpoint. Returns a list of visual matches with titles, source URLs, links, and thumbnails. The agent invokes the tool by passing the runtime identifier of the target image. The tool performs reverse search (image → \rightarrow information) on a single image per call; finding images from a text description is instead handled by Text Search with an image-search intent. A separate multimodal summarizer prompt C.1 reranks the candidates against the query image and produces the same JSON envelope as Text Search.
blocks.zh: 使用Serper的反向图像搜索(Google Lens)端点, 返回带有标题、源 URL、链接和缩略图的可视匹配列表。 代理通过传递目标图像的运行时间标识符来引用工具. 该工具每个调用一个图像进行反向搜索(图像 ~\ 右旋信息);从文本描述中查找图像则由文本搜索处理,意图是图像搜索. 一个单独的多模式摘要快取C.1将考生与查询图像进行重新排序,并产生与文本搜索相同的JSON信封.

blocks.en: Image Search summarizer prompt (abridged) You are a visual-match summarizer. Given raw reverse-image-search results (and, in the multimodal variant, the query image plus each candidate’s thumbnail), do exactly three things: 1. RERANK the numbered matches by how likely each identifies the same subject as the query image. 2. KEEP at most K K most useful matches as kept_indices . 3. SUMMARIZE what the FULL set of raw matches indicates about the query image’s likely subject in a concise 3–5 sentence prose paragraph; capture entity names, dates, attributes verbatim. Output STRICT JSON with {kept indices, summary, no results justification, suggested next actions} ; when no match is useful, justify per-match and propose follow-up actions such as cropping with Visual Grounding before re-searching, or switching to Text Search.
blocks.zh: 图像搜索摘要提示 (简写) 你是一个视觉游戏的总结。 鉴于原始反向图像搜索结果(在多式变体中,查询图像加上每个候选人的缩略图),可以做三件事: 1. 重新列出编号匹配符,按每一方可能如何识别与查询图像相同的主题。 2. 最多保持 K K 最有用的匹配值为保持_indices。 3. 在简洁的3至5句旁白段落中,概括了FulL系列原始匹配所显示的关于查询图像可能的主题的内容;记录实体名称、日期和属性。 输出 STRICT JSON 有 {kept 索引,摘要,无结果说明,建议下一步行动};在没有匹配有用时,说明每次匹配的理由并提议后续行动,如在重新研究前用可视地面裁剪,或切换到文本搜索.

blocks.en: RERANK the numbered matches by how likely each identifies the same subject as the query image.
blocks.zh: 重新列出编号匹配符,按每个选项如何识别与查询图像相同的主题。

blocks.en: KEEP at most K K most useful matches as kept_indices .
blocks.zh: 最多 K K 最有用的匹配 。

blocks.en: SUMMARIZE what the FULL set of raw matches indicates about the query image’s likely subject in a concise 3–5 sentence prose paragraph; capture entity names, dates, attributes verbatim.
blocks.zh: Summarize FULL 一组原始匹配在简洁的 3– 5 句义段落中对查询图像可能的主题表示什么; 抓取实体名称、 日期、 属性逐字记录 。

blocks.en: Visit one or more webpages, convert them to plain text via Serper APIs, and extract goal-relevant content using a local Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model. This tool returns per-URL evidence and a summary. The extraction prompt is shown in C.1 .
blocks.zh: 访问一个或多个网页,通过Serper API将其转换为纯文本,并使用本地的Quen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型提取出与目标相关的内容. 此工具返回每个URL的证据和摘要 。 提取提示以 C.1 表示 。

blocks.en: Webpage Visit extraction prompt Please process the following webpage content and user goal to extract relevant information: Webpage Content : {webpage_content} User Goal : {goal} Task Guidelines 1. Content scanning for rationale : locate the specific sections directly related to the user’s goal. 2. Key extraction for evidence : extract the most relevant information; preserve the full original context whenever possible. 3. Summary output : organize the result into a concise paragraph with logical flow that connects the evidence back to the goal. Output: a single JSON object with keys rational , evidence , and summary (each a string; empty string if no content is available). No code fences, no Markdown, no extra keys.
blocks.zh: 网页访问提取提示 请处理以下网页内容和用户目标以提取相关信息: 网页内容 : {网页_内容} 用户目标:{目标}任务准则 1. 内容扫描说明理由:查找与用户目标直接相关的具体章节。 2. 提取证据的关键:提取最相关的信息;尽可能保留全部原始内容。 3. 产出摘要:将结果组织成一个简明的段落,其中包含将证据与目标联系起来的逻辑流程。 输出(Outsion):一个有键理性的JSON对象,证据,和摘要(每个字符串;如果没有内容,则空字符串). 没有密码围栏,没有Markdown, 没有额外的钥匙。

blocks.en: Content scanning for rationale : locate the specific sections directly related to the user’s goal.
blocks.zh: 内容扫描理由:查找与用户目标直接相关的具体章节。

blocks.en: Key extraction for evidence : extract the most relevant information; preserve the full original context whenever possible.
blocks.zh: 提取证据的密钥:提取最相关的信息;尽可能保留完整的原始上下文。

blocks.en: Summary output : organize the result into a concise paragraph with logical flow that connects the evidence back to the goal.
blocks.zh: 汇总输出 : 将结果组织成有逻辑流的简明段落,将证据与目标相接.

blocks.en: C.2 Visual Tools
blocks.zh: C.2 视觉工具

blocks.en: Crop a region of an image given a normalized bounding box on the [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] scale plus padding, and return the cropped image. Used for closer visual inspection after the agent has already localized a region of interest.
blocks.zh: 在 [0, 1000] [0, 1000] 比例尺上裁剪一个图像给定的正框区域并返回所裁剪的图像。 在毒剂已经将一个感兴趣的区域定位后,用于进行更严密的视觉检查。

blocks.en: Locate and highlight regions of an image that match a text query, backed by SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) . It returns an annotated image with matched regions highlighted and numbered, along with bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 定位和突出匹配文本查询的图像区域,由SAM3(Carion等,2026年)支持。 它返回带有相应区域并加亮和编号的附加说明的图像以及边框。

blocks.en: Extract readable text from an image, backed by PaddleOCR-VL ( Cui et al., 2025 ) . Returns the transcribed text as a single string. Used when the task is about words, numbers, or printed labels in the image; not for general object localization or segmentation.
blocks.zh: 从一个图像取出可读文本,由PaddleOCR-VL(Cui等,2025年)支持. 以单一字符串的形式返回已转录的文本。 当任务涉及文字,数字,或图像中被打印出标签时使用;不是用于一般对象定位或分割.

blocks.en: Estimate a per-pixel depth map for an input image, backed by Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . Returns a depth image (closer surfaces brighter, farther darker). Used when the task requires reasoning about relative distance, foreground–background separation, or 3D scene structure cues that flat 2D crops cannot resolve.

blocks.en: C.3 Code-Execution Tool

blocks.en: GPT-5 produces structurally rich tools: modular helper functions, tiered authority ranking of knowledge sources, and multi-layer fallback chains. Qwen3-VL-32B passes 81% of candidates with clean but simpler code. Qwen3-VL-8B succeeds on only 29%; manual inspection reveals logic bugs that survive the gates but would fail at runtime (see Appendix G for code examples). We adopt GPT-5 as the default generator, accepting its API cost in exchange for the structurally richer code.

blocks.en: Appendix I Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录一 定性分析

blocks.en: We present additional case studies; three patterns account for the gains:
blocks.zh: 我们提出更多的个案研究;其中的三个模式反映了收益:

blocks.en: 1. Perceive-then-query. The generated tool chains visual identification (Lens) with structured lookup (Wikidata, text search), forcing the agent to identify the entity before searching for facts. The base agent often skips identification and searches for the wrong entity. 2. Specialized lookup. The generated tool directly answers a specific attribute query (e.g. aircraft model year, building architect) via a targeted chain-call pipeline, replacing the base agent’s generic multi-step search. 3. Forced verification. The generated tool prevents the agent from answering from internal knowledge alone (zero-tool hallucination) by requiring a lookup step.
blocks.zh: 1. 感应时的平静。 已生成的工具链可视化识别(Lens)带有结构化的搜索(Wikidata,文本搜索),迫使代理在搜索事实之前先识别实体. 基地代理经常会跳过识别和搜索错误的实体. 2. 专门检查。 所生成的工具通过定向的连线调用管道直接回答特定属性查询(如飞机模型年,建筑建筑师),取而代之的是基地代理的通用多步骤搜索. 3. 强制核查。 所生成的工具要求一个取景步骤,从而阻止了特效单独从内部知识中解答(零工具幻觉).

blocks.en: Figures 3 – 6 present four representative gained samples. The first three illustrate the perceive-then-query pattern at the entity (Figures 3 and 4 ) and region (Figure 5 ) levels; the fourth (Figure 6 ) shows a generated tool re-ranking search results toward higher-authority sources even when both pipelines call similar primitives.
blocks.zh: 图3 - 6 现共有四名代表获得样本。 前三段说明了实体(图3和图4)和区域(图5)各级的感知-当时的平稳模式;第四段(图6)显示了一种生成的工具重新排序的搜索结果,即使两个管道都称为相类似的原始物。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Entity-first identification (Reed Hastings, $50M Hastings Initiative). The base agent searches without knowing who is in the image and misattributes the donation to Eric Schmidt; the generated \toolhl Image Entity Canonical Name tool resolves the person first, after which a single text search returns the correct year.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Entity-first identification on a person whose visual context provides only vague cues. The base agent guesses “Mississippi” from incidental visual content and returns the wrong pageant; the generated \toolhl Celebrated Person From Image tool produces the canonical identity (Beatrice Luigi Gomez), which makes the event lookup trivial.
blocks.zh: 图4:在视觉环境仅提供模糊提示的人身上进行实体第一识别。 基本代理从偶然的视觉内容猜测“Mississippi”并返回错误的选美;生成的\toolhl Concerated Person From Image工具生成了犬类身份(Beatrice Luigi Gomez),这使得事件看起来微不足道。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Precise region identification on a US map. Without explicit map-region parsing the base agent confuses Oregon with neighboring Washington and returns the wrong governor; the generated \toolhl State Context Lookup tool pins down the highlighted state first, after which the governor lookup succeeds.
blocks.zh: 图5:美国地图上的精确区域识别。 不清晰的地图区域解析底线代理将俄勒冈州与相邻的华盛顿州混淆并返回错误的州长;生成的\toolhl州背景查找工具先将突出的州钉住,之后州长查询成功.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Search-ranking steering. The base agent’s generic image search returns multiple election maps and the agent latches onto a Reddit thread about the wrong year; the generated \toolhl Event Name From Image tool primes the search for an event-name extraction and reorders the results so Wikipedia (1996) outranks Reddit (1968).
blocks.zh: 图6:搜索级方向. 基准代理的通用图像搜索返回了多个选举地图,代理服务器的latches在Reddit线条上记录了错误的年份;生成的\toolhl Event Name From Image 工具质点搜索事件名称提取并重排结果,所以维基百科(1996年)排名Reddit(1968年).
